username.label: Username
username.description: Used to sign in and for people to mention you with @.

logout.label: Sign out
logout.description: Ends the session in this browser.
logout.descriptionInCall: Ends the session in this browser and also leaves the call in progress.

delete.label: Delete my account
delete.description_one: The account is deleted {{count}} day after you ask. Signing in again before then cancels it.
delete.description_other: The account is deleted {{count}} days after you ask. Signing in again before then cancels it.
delete.consequences_one: You will be signed out of every device now, and the account will be deleted in {{count}} day:
delete.consequences_other: You will be signed out of every device now, and the account will be deleted in {{count}} days:
delete.whatGoes: Your profile, friends, blocks, connections and profile pictures are erased.
delete.servers: The servers you created pass to their longest-standing member; a server with nobody else left is deleted.
delete.messages: Your messages stay in their conversations, without your name. To keep a copy, download your data in Data & privacy first.
delete.cancel_one: Changed your mind? Sign in again within {{count}} day and the deletion is cancelled.
delete.cancel_other: Changed your mind? Sign in again within {{count}} days and the deletion is cancelled.
delete.codeSent: We sent a code to {{email}}. Type it to confirm the deletion.
delete.failed: Could not delete the account. Try again.

email.changeHint: Used to recover your account. We ask for your current password, and the change is confirmed with a code sent to the new email. With two-step verification on, the current email gets a code too.
email.codeSent: Enter the code sent to {{email}}. It expires in 30 minutes.
email.codeHint: Enter the 6 digits sent to your email.
email.codeError: Check the code and try again.

validation.same: Enter an email different from the current one.

email.label: Email

email.currentCodeAria: Code sent to the current email
email.changedEndedSessions_one: Email changed to {{email}}. {{count}} other session was ended.
email.changedEndedSessions_other: Email changed to {{email}}. {{count}} other sessions were ended.

privacy.description: People you block can't message you or call you in a private conversation. Unblocking doesn't restore the friendship: you have to add each other again.
privacy.emptyText: Anyone you block shows up here, and you can unblock them any time.

export.label: Download my data
export.description: A copy of your profile, settings, friends, blocks, servers and every message you sent, with its files. We email you when it is ready.
export.buildingHint: We are preparing your copy. You can leave this page: the link also arrives by email.
export.failed: Your copy could not be prepared. Ask again.
export.expired: The link to your last copy has expired.
export.nextRequest: You can ask for another copy from {{date}}.
export.requestFailed: Could not ask for a copy. Try again.
export.loadFailed: Could not load the state of your copy.

stats.label: Show statistics
stats.description: Bitrate and time live in each stream's menu.

compress.description: Reduces the size before sending. Applies to new attachments from now on. One you've already prepared isn't reprocessed.
